import sys, json, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import main as impl, fuzz2
rng = random.Random(77)
ok = True
for trial in range(80):
    req = fuzz2.gen_medium(rng)
    base = impl.process(json.dumps(req).encode())
    for _ in range(4):
        rules = req['rules'][:]
        rng.shuffle(rules)
        req2 = {'services':req['services'],'rules':rules,'queries':req['queries']}
        out = impl.process(json.dumps(req2).encode())
        if out != base:
            ok = False
            print('PERMUTATION DIFFERENCE')
            print(json.dumps(req))
            print(base[:300]); print(out[:300]); break
    if not ok: break
print('rule permutation invariance:', 'ok' if ok else 'FAILED')

# equivalent bundles expressed differently must give identical deployment maps
equiv_pairs = [
  # same language, different expressions
  ({"services":["a","b"],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"match","path":["a","b"]}}],"queries":[[],["a"],["a","b"]]},
   {"services":["a","b"],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"and","args":[{"op":"match","path":["a","b"]},{"op":"true"}]}}],"queries":[[],["a"],["a","b"]]}),
  ({"services":["a","b"],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"contains","path":["a","b"]}}],"queries":[[]]},
   {"services":["a","b"],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"or","args":[{"op":"startswith","path":["a","b"]},{"op":"endswith","path":["a","b"]},{"op":"contains","path":["a","b"]},{"op":"contains","path":["a","b"]}]}}],"queries":[[]]}),
  ({"services":["a"],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"true"}}],"queries":[[],["a"]]},
   {"services":["a"],"rules":[{"action":"allow","when":{"op":"or","args":[]}}],"queries":[[],["a"]]}),
]
for a, b in equiv_pairs:
    oa = impl.process(json.dumps(a).encode()); ob = impl.process(json.dumps(b).encode())
    print('equiv' if oa == ob else 'DIFF!', oa[:60])
